Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached existing game buff/debuff icon atlas. Redraw its cells as polished authentic Stardew Valley 16x16 status icons. The SUBJECT LIST below is the exact required order, read LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM. Preserve ALL cell identities and positions. Each icon is truly LOW RESOLUTION on a logical 16x16 grid, shown as large crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks. Use a chunky one-logical-pixel warm dark-brown outline, 3 tones per material with hue-shifted shadows, restrained bright vanilla Stardew colors and small upper-left highlights. Clear strong silhouettes and minimal detail, legible at actual 16x16 pixels. Each subject fills roughly 12-14 logical pixels inside its cell, centered with 1-2 logical transparent pixels of margin. Small phase badges and treatment green-plus badges must be legible chunky 3x3 logical pixels at lower right, without hiding the base subject. In injury phases use consistent red acute / amber healing / green recovery accents, and distinguish phase by the visible dressing or recovery symbol as well as color. Do not replace meaningful symbols with identical generic crosses. Positive care uses warm cream, green and gold; injuries use red/amber skin and ivory; fear uses violet/navy/cool blue. Actual transparent alpha background. NO checkerboard, NO square tile backgrounds, NO borders between cells, NO labels, NO numbers, NO watermark, NO smooth gradients, NO antialiasing, NO realistic illustration, NO soft shadows, NO extra icons.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, SQUARE atlas.
EXACT SUBJECTS IN CELL ORDER:
1. general treatment: an ivory bandage roll beside a small green medical cross
2. intensive care: pale blue IV fluid bag and short tube
3. outpatient care after serious injury: cream clipboard with a tiny pink heart
4. healing: two fresh green leaves over a small healed pink wound
5. recovery: pink heart with a single green leaf
6. protection: blue shield with a small ivory medical cross
7. antibiotics: red and cream capsule with a tiny green plus badge
8. medicinal dropper: pale glass pipette with a large red rubber bulb
9. Teracitin medicine: sealed turquoise glass ampoule with gray cap
10. calming tea: ivory cup of green herbal tea with steam
11. strict supervision: open blue eye with a small gold alert marker
12. emergency supervision: bright red emergency beacon on dark silver base
13. constant supervision: open blue eye with a tiny gold clock badge
14. sedation: pale blue syringe with a small lavender crescent
15. post-surgical care: peach forearm with three dark stitches and a small pink heart
16. trauma healing: pink heart wrapped in ivory bandage with one golden sparkle
